rules.textTransformations: Remove verified leading citation/chapter/subchapter labels; trim section-fragment edge whitespace; represent a paragraph boundary within one section as two newlines.
rules.editorialChanges: None. Original spelling, punctuation and internal whitespace are retained.
rules.specialPunctuation: Punctuation outside the verified structural labels is retained, including the Book I dash after CAP. XI. and apostrophe after CAP. XVI.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode alphanumeric runs matched by [^\W_]+; no case folding or stemming.
rules.offsetDefinition: Zero-based Python Unicode character offsets, end exclusive: sourceText/text offsets refer to the paragraph's concatenated XML text; recordText offsets refer to the indexed section text.
rules.orderDefinition: Source section order within each book; global order continues across Books I–VII.
rules.readerRouteEvidence: assets/js/renderTei.js: Bellum uses Cardwell by default and accepts book/niese URL parameters.
